description: This file contains utility mixins and functions used in Bootstrap's SCSS source code, including order assertion for maps, string replacements, color contrast calculations, and theme color retrieval.

methods.name: _assert-ascending
methods.description: Mixin to verify that a map’s keys or values are in ascending order, issuing warnings if not.

methods.name: _assert-starts-at-zero
methods.description: Mixin to ensure that the first value in a breakpoint map starts at zero, issuing a warning if not.
